dialogue_segments.label: BALD THUG (Cruel, Laughing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BALD THUG
dialogue_segments.text: Look at her! Crying over weeds!

dialogue_segments.label: THUG WITH CAP (Challenging, Arrogant)
dialogue_segments.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
dialogue_segments.text: What? You want to fight us, veteran?

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: The Thug with Cap violently shoves Juliana back with both hands; she cries out as she loses her balance and crashes hard onto the wet stone path.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Juliana crawls forward on her elbows; fresh crimson blood seeps profusely through her white gauze bandages as she reaches for the ruined blossoms.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: The Tall Thug hoists his heavy wooden club above his head to crush the remaining herbs right before Juliana.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Alexander storms forward with lethal intensity, dark hair flying, breath misting in the cold, radiating untamed rage.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Alexander places himself directly between Juliana and the three thugs, staring them down with cold, deadly intent.
